message.content: Columbia University is a prestigious private Ivy League research institution located in New York City, United States. It was founded in 1754 as King's College and became Columbia College in 1784, later evolving into Columbia University. The campus spans several boroughs—most notably Morningside Heights on Manhattan’s Upper West Side—and includes multiple schools such as Columbia Law School, Columbia Business School, Columbia Engineering, and the Columbia Graduate School of Arts & Sciences. Known for its rigorous academics, diverse student body, and influential alumni—including numerous Nobel laureates, U.S. presidents, and leaders across various fields—Columbia remains one of the world’s leading universities.
